heading: EPF Withdrawal Rules: Form 121 Replaces Forms 15G and 15H
tldr: From April 1, 2026, a new declaration, Form 121, will replace Forms 15G and 15H for reducing TDS on certain incomes.
This change impacts eligible taxpayers seeking relief from Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) on specific types of income.
For EPF withdrawals, Form 121 will serve as the declaration for individuals whose total taxable income for the year is below the basic exemption limit.
Submitting Form 121 helps avoid TDS at the time of withdrawal, but it does not make a taxable EPF withdrawal tax-free.
Taxpayers must ensure they meet the eligibility criteria for Form 121 to prevent incorrect TDS deductions.
caption:
Got an EPF account? Big news about how you withdraw your money! From April 2026, there's a new form called Form 121. It replaces old forms (15G/15H) for reducing tax taken out of your EPF withdrawal if your income is low. This helps you avoid upfront tax deductions. Learn how this change affects you and your savings by reading the full article.
